output.summary: The claim was denied because prior authorization was not obtained for an outpatient MRI under policy V2025. An appeal is possible if a specialist referral is submitted.

items.text: Obtain a written referral from a board‑certified specialist for the outpatient MRI.
File an appeal within 180 days, attaching the specialist referral as required by Section 4.2.
Case HC-004 was overturned when a specialist referral was provided; it demonstrates that the same evidence satisfies the appeal requirement.
